seo.title: About
seo.description: Kura is modern finance, redesigned — one account to save, spend, invest, earn, and move money globally, with privacy by default and the simplicity of a bank.
seo.keywords: about Kura, modern finance, zero-access, non-custodial, financial account, TrackFi, Kura Card

hero.title: Modern finance, redesigned.
hero.description: One account to save, spend, invest, earn, and move money globally — with the simplicity of a bank and the freedom of modern finance.

mission.label: Mission
mission.title: A financial life that stays yours.
mission.description: We build software, not a vault. Kura is non-custodial and Zero-Access by design: you authorize moves, partners handle regulated rails, and we never need universal plaintext access to your money or TrackFi connections to ship a beautiful product.

principles.title: Beautiful by default
principles.description: Finance should feel calm and intentional — not like a terminal. We obsess over clarity so everyday money decisions feel simple.

principles.title: Privacy by architecture
principles.description: Zero-Access design and non-custodial control mean we do not need to hold your keys or read your connected financial life to operate the product.

principles.title: Global without the friction
principles.description: On / off ramps, multi-currency balances, Trade, Earn, and US markets — through regulated partners — so borders feel less like barriers.

product.label: Product
product.title: One account. Pick what you need.
product.description: Cash, Trade, On / Off Ramps, Earn, US stocks, card spend, and portfolio tracking work better together — and never force you to take the whole stack.

pillars.label: Account
pillars.title: One place for cash
pillars.description: Hold, send, and receive with bank-like clarity — multi-currency and global transfers included.

pillars.label: Grow
pillars.title: Invest, earn, borrow
pillars.description: US stocks via Dinari, optional Morpho yield, and on-demand liquidity — when you want them, not because you must.

pillars.label: Spend
pillars.title: Kura Card
pillars.description: Spend from your balance anywhere Visa is accepted. Virtual card today; physical card on the waitlist.

pillars.label: See everything
pillars.title: TrackFi
pillars.description: Encrypted portfolio tracking for banks, brokerages, and on-chain positions — without giving us plaintext visibility.

founder.label: Founder
founder.title: A note from Rick
paragraphs: I am not a trader, and I am not an arbitrageur. I wanted a simple place to manage bank accounts, card spending, stocks, crypto, and on-chain yield — without juggling five apps or surrendering privacy for convenience.
I could not find that product. So I built Kura: modern finance with a bank-like calm, Zero-Access privacy, and partners for the rails that must be regulated.
founder.name: Rick Weng

evolution.label: Evolution
evolution.title: How Kura grew into one account.

milestones.title: TrackFi
milestones.content: Encrypted portfolio tracking for banking, investments, and digital assets — Zero-Access so readable financial data stays off our servers.

milestones.title: Unified financial account
milestones.content: Cash, transfers, and a calm bank-like experience in one place — add money, send globally, and see balance and history clearly.

milestones.title: Invest, Earn & Borrow
milestones.content: US equities, transparent yield, and Morpho liquidity — powered by regulated and protocol partners with terms you can read.

milestones.title: Kura Card
milestones.content: Turn balance into everyday spend: virtual card live, physical Kura Card waitlist for cashback and fee-free international use.

milestones.title: Business & Team
milestones.content: Shared Treasury, Approvals, Team roles, and Reports on the Pro web dashboard — company cash without a second stack of tools.

trust.label: Trust
trust.title: Built in the open where it matters.
trust.description: Corporate details, Zero-Access posture, and the partner stack that powers regulated functions live in our Trust & Security Center.
